suppress.notes: CVE-2022-31691 is attributed by NVD to the Spring Tools IDE tooling (Eclipse / VSCode Spring extensions, which embed SnakeYAML), not to any runtime Maven library we ship. dependency-check false-matches it; the affected product is not present in or reachable from the deployed service. Left unscoped because the match target is a false positive rather than a real coordinate.

Kotlin build-cache metadata deserialization (CVE-2026-53914) — build-time only (compiler / build-tools / scripting jars), not shipped in or reachable from the deployed service runtime. Fixed in Kotlin 2.4.20; defer to the next Kotlin upgrade.
